A public text reader has these proposed controls and notices.

Header: `meatybroth.com`; tagline: `AI slop or human broth? Who cares as long as it’s meaty`.

Controls: `View:` with Topics, Latest, Words, Meaning, With replies, and Network. `Find:` accepts `words, "exact phrase"`. `Sort:` has Relevance and Newest. Buttons are `Words` and `Meaning`. `Search in:` has MiniLM and Titan. Topics also has `Group by:` Fixed number or DBSCAN, then `Topic:` with `Choose a topic` and topic labels/counts. Network has `Through follows:` 1/2/3 hops and `Order:` Newest/Most connected.

Help text: Latest: Recent posts, newest first. Words: Posts containing these words. Meaning: Posts related to your query. It can find posts without the same words. Similar posts: Posts related to this post. Topics: Groups of related posts. Choose a topic below. With replies: Threads with recent replies. A search limits this view to matching threads. Network: Posts from accounts near the people you follow. The follow graph here is incomplete.

Page notice: `Posts from the last 30 days stored here. Status`

A card has a linked author, a non-linked age and score, then linked `Replies`, `Similar`, `Event`, and `Post details`. If Similar is pending: `Similar posts will appear after this post is indexed.`

Status says: `Updated [time]. [count] posts are available from the last 30 days.` Then: `Collection checks selected relays. Gaps and missing profiles are listed below.` It has Collection, Content filters, and Related-post index sections. Index summary is `[backend]: [ready] posts ready, [pending] waiting.` Model IDs, hashes, request/cost counts, and raw relay reports are in expandable details.
